tools.name: status
tools.description: State of the served vault: its path, the spec and mdk versions, the claimed conformance level (spec §12), the embedder of its index (spec §9), its last checkpoint (spec §8) and the active policy recipe (promotion policy, spec §7). Writes nothing.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Retrieval as of a checkpoint (spec §9): ranked chunks for a query, lexical (BM25), flat (exact cosine) or hybrid (reciprocal rank fusion, the default), at the checkpoint `at` or at the checkpoint of the current state. Only `canonical` content is returned unless `include_proposal` is set; then up to `k` `proposal` chunks, ranked apart with the canonical statistics, labelled `proposal` with their score multiplied by 0.5, follow the unchanged canonical hits (spec §7, §9). `derived` is never returned. Records one consumption trace for the calling consumer (spec §8). An empty or whitespace-only query is an error and records nothing.

at.description: checkpoint id or name (default: the current state's)

include_proposal.description: also return labelled proposal chunks (default false)

query.description: the query text (not empty, not only whitespace)

tools.name: read_block
tools.description: One block as of a checkpoint (spec §8): its version (version id, type, text, heading path, parents), layer (spec §7) and provenance (author kind, source), for lineage `lineage_id` of document `doc_path`; at checkpoint `at` or at the checkpoint of the current state. Records one consumption trace for the calling consumer. A `derived` block is never returned; a lineage that is not live in that document at that checkpoint is an error and records nothing.

at.description: checkpoint id or name (default: the current state's)

doc_path.description: vault-relative path of the Markdown document

tools.name: history
tools.description: Version chain of one lineage (spec §4–§5): every event of the log that names it (created, updated, moved, split, merged, deleted, promoted, demoted, layer changed), in log order, and its current layer (spec §7). Writes nothing.

tools.name: blame
tools.description: Provenance of a document block by block, in document order (spec §4.3, §7): per block its lineage id, version id, layer (canonical, proposal, derived), author kind, source and the log offsets that created and last changed it; at the head, or as of a checkpoint (spec §8). Writes nothing.

at.description: checkpoint id or name (default: the head)

doc_path.description: vault-relative path of a Markdown document

tools.name: propose
tools.description: The only way an agent writes Markdown (spec §7, K8): the agent's text is written into the vault as plain Markdown — a new document (`mode` create, the default; an existing document is never overwritten), appended to an existing one (`append`), or as the body of the section under `heading` (`replace_section`) — and ingested with `author_kind` agent and the consumer as source, so new and changed blocks are `proposal`, excluded from default retrieval until a human promotes them. The vault's edit policy decides first (`[edit]`, default `append_only`): a write that would change or remove a `canonical` block, or a canonical retrieval unit (text appended to a section of canonical blocks joins their chunk; start it with a heading of its own), is refused with code `denied` and writes nothing; `replace_section` is allowed only on a section made of proposals. Change and delete events name the actor (spec §4.3). Nothing but the agent's text is written to the file (no ids, no metadata). `reason` is recorded beside the vault (`.mdkernel/proposals.jsonl`). The path must stay inside the vault (no `..`, no absolute path, no hidden directory) and the text may not exceed the server's `max_propose_bytes`.

reason.description: why the agent proposes this (recorded, not written to the document)

tools.name: promote
tools.description: Request the promotion of a lineage from `proposal` to `canonical` (spec §7). The kernel does not decide: the vault's promotion policy hook does, for the actor the channel gives (it cannot be chosen): over MCP the agent agent:<client>, over HTTP the vault's human human:<[identity] human_id>. Under `human_only` (the default) an agent's request is denied: the answer is `decision: denied` with the policy and its reason, not an error, and no event is written; a human's request writes a `Promoted` event (`decision: promoted`). `deny` refuses everyone.

tools.name: checkpoint
tools.description: Create a checkpoint of the vault's current state (spec §8): an immutable map doc path → snapshot at an event offset, optionally named; the same state gives the same checkpoint id. Queries can then be evaluated as of it (`search at`, `blame at`, `read_block at`). Returns the checkpoint. A state has one checkpoint: if a search or read already created its unnamed checkpoint, `name` names that one (same id, a `CheckpointNamed` event). A name another checkpoint holds, or another name for an already named state, is an error (`exists`).

tools.name: checkpoints
tools.description: Every checkpoint of the vault (spec §8: checkpoint id, optional name, event offset, snapshot per document), in creation order. Writes nothing.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Consumption traces (spec §8): which block versions (doc path, lineage id, version id) each retrieval returned, with its checkpoint, consumer and query hash; from trace offset `since_seq`, optionally for one consumer. Writes nothing.
